MDG.note: The article states no rule or authority on AI harms.
The only AI component is in customs, a sector system.

facts.fact: Madagascar's Customs Directorate launched the pilot phase of a Korean-customs-financed project in which ERA (Enhanced Risk Management), an automated AI risk system, will be integrated into the Sydonia World clearance platform.

MDG.note: ERA is a customs system financed by Korean customs; no local AI model, dataset or computing is stated.

facts.fact: Madagascar's Customs Directorate clears goods on Sydonia World, described as the current clearance platform, and launched a pilot to improve its electronic clearance system.
